name: Shielded pool phase 2 — contribution 3 (tosdev3)
body:
Third signed contribution, by **tosdev3**, to the open phase-2 ceremony. Drawn on a
second machine from a different provider than contributions 1 and 2.

- Contribution: `5619a6e1aab154546061a8c65b35f98a973fc69f365b8665d702e0e82e96e468`
- Transcript: `d05541b101c7c94a85bdcb3491a66d3448ec7e955b2e080825e75cdfbdfdf21f`
- Register revision `8865f435d5ccbfa4aba5f7fc8063d9bda65c83d6`, published before this contribution record.
- `phase2-verify`: the chain audits, 3 contributions, NOT FINISHED as expected before the beacon.
- `verify-attestations.py --in-progress`: all three attestations verify against the published register.

**None of the three contributions is independent of the operator.** Run without
`--in-progress`, the attestation verifier **refuses** this ceremony and exits 1. That
refusing run is in the evidence directory. A third machine spreads the risk that one
host's generator or memory was compromised — a phase-2 ceremony is sound if any single
scalar was honestly drawn and destroyed. It does not spread the risk the independence
rule is about, which is whether some contributor could draw and destroy a scalar without
the others being able to compel or observe them. All three draws were made by one party
on hardware that party administers.

Before extending the chain, the published contribution-2 archive was verified against its
recorded digest, eleven of its files compared byte for byte against the published branch,
and both existing attestations verified against the published register. That evidence is
included.

Open ceremony, not final parameters. Contributions close at Bitcoin 970141; beacon at 970285.
Observed 968141 from both announced witnesses at 2026-09-22T12:26:00Z, after contributing.

[Contribution record and validation](https://github.com/tosnetwork/tos/blob/315a8bcb8e920cb8db2c37ed5b8ff75fb1ff2c2e/artifacts/phase2/CONTRIBUTION-3.md).

The archive carries only public ceremony files, all three signed attestations, the
registered public keys, the announcement and verification evidence. No signing private key
is included. It is packed with normalized owner and timestamps and without extended
attributes.

Archive SHA-256: `3fe7f063eec267044d24371bfa21e2af91e7a62dcd0a70a3db9abac7f367263c`
